json.perspective: Top-three feature gaps prioritized strictly by coded mention counts from 38 public-review excerpts.

gaps.title: Guided, role-based onboarding and contextual help
gaps.whyNow: 16 of 38 review excerpts referenced onboarding & usability issues, the highest-coded theme, indicating setup and discoverability are primary pain points.
gaps.recommendedFeature: In-product guided onboarding wizard with role-based setup templates, an interactive first-run checklist, contextual tooltips, and a persistent “Help & Escalate” button that captures user state for support.

gaps.title: One-click human escalation with contextual handoff
gaps.whyNow: 15 of 38 review excerpts mentioned the need for human escalation, showing many users require live support or manual intervention beyond self-service.
gaps.recommendedFeature: An in-app “Escalate to human” flow that auto-captures session context and relevant logs, routes incidents to tiered support queues with SLA timers, and provides a structured handoff interface for support agents to resume the user's session.

gaps.title: Centralized account trust, audit, and approval controls
gaps.whyNow: 10 of 38 review excerpts raised account-trust concerns, signaling measurable demand for clearer visibility and controls over account activity and access.
gaps.recommendedFeature: An Account Trust Center featuring immutable admin audit logs, configurable approval workflows for critical actions, real-time anomaly alerts, and a transparent change-history UI for admins and auditors.
